conceptual_lifetime_states.obligation: Review domain/provenance and existing call boundary; no byte read.
Require proven writer ordering, ownership and bounded storage; no consumer reads.
Require completed capture with private exact logical bytes and no writable escape.
Retain the complete storage/exporter/view dependency chain; consume only within trusted scope.
No mutation/release/escape; consumer and all byte uses remain held until confirmed completion.
Only a successful complete digest is eligible to return at the original call site; bound ownership cleanup remains required.
All owned observation resources are confirmed unused and released; no reusable capture/digest cache.
Preserve primary failure, no digest/receipt; retain resources for unconfirmed work within original cleanup/idle gates.
Owned work confirmed quiescent and dependencies released; failed status remains, no retry.

failure_transition_rule: Failure at any unfinished state yields no success result. Keep dependencies held if use is unconfirmed; release only after confirmed quiescence. Preserve primary error and original idle/deadline gates; no new allowance, retry or failure promotion.
future_evidence_required: Actual target build/source/consumer provenance and dispatch
Original-domain exact bytes/refusals and writer/capture/consumer lifetime proof
Actual complete-unit preparation/scoring/observation/cleanup timing and memory with fresh replay

state_digest.recipe: In original state_dict order: SHA256.update(name.encode()); SHA256.update(detach -> cpu -> contiguous -> numpy -> tobytes(default C order)); final hexdigest. No inserted delimiters.

tensor_hash.recipe: detach -> cpu -> contiguous -> reshape(-1) -> view(uint8) -> numpy -> tobytes(default C order) -> SHA256.hexdigest

requirements.name: Source and build provenance
requirements.requirement: Join actual Torch2.8.0+cu128/CUDA12.8, NumPy2.4.6, CPython3.11.17 and dispatch to reviewed source before asserting physical behavior. Frozen upstream tag/template or equal metadata is insufficient.

requirements.name: Original domain and refusals
requirements.requirement: Preserve every original accepted dtype/layout/device/dispatch case and original operator/refusal ordering. Do not normalize unsupported inputs, bypass conjugate/negative/subclass/layout checks, or replace uint8 reinterpretation with numeric conversion. Unknown equivalence blocks adoption.

requirements.name: Fresh observation and call position
requirements.requirement: Each reached original call performs a fresh observation at its original boundary, including repeated Snapshot.check and OwnedStep.tokens calls when identity/version is unchanged. No hash/version cache, deduplication, movement across gradients, scoring, journals, restoration or receipts.

requirements.name: Source capture ordering
requirements.requirement: Prove all relevant CPU/CUDA writers quiescent and ordered through capture completion. Original tobytes creates an owned result after copying; neither that operation nor this contract proves an atomic source capture. Missing writer/order evidence is unresolved, never inferred from GIL, version, owner metadata or readonly flags.

requirements.name: Private storage
requirements.requirement: Prove the captured bytes are independent of caller/source writers and not an alias of original tensor, storage or exported mutable buffers. Copy requests and allocation identity metadata alone do not prove this. A private tensor is still writable unless its writer access is controlled.

requirements.name: Transfer completion and stream domain
requirements.requirement: Complete the ordered capture/transfer before any byte read. Match completion evidence to its owner, allocation generation, device and stream/domain; current-stream synchronization is not proof that unrelated writers have been ordered. Unknown/in-flight work forbids consume or premature release.

requirements.name: Tensor hash byte contract
requirements.requirement: Match the original detach, CPU transfer, logical contiguous layout, reshape(-1), view(uint8), NumPy export and default C-order bytes exactly, then SHA256/hexdigest. Preserve extent, storage offset treatment, dtype bits, logical order and refusals. Hash no storage padding/capacity and perform no numeric conversion.

requirements.name: Separate state digest contract
requirements.requirement: Retain state_dict iteration order. For each item, update SHA256 with name.encode() and tensor.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes() in that order, then hexdigest. Add no delimiter or metadata and do not substitute the flattened uint8 tensor_hash recipe. No parameter/state/RNG/mode mutation.

requirements.name: Exporter containment and trusted consumption
requirements.requirement: Keep every mutable capture/exporter/storage/base alias inside the trusted observation lifetime. Do not expose a writer, view.obj/base/storage mutator, callback or reentrant path that can change/free bytes during consumption. A readonly view alone proves only that view disallows assignment. Consumer implementation and buffer retention still need versioned review.

requirements.name: Lifetime and bounded release
requirements.requirement: Retain source as required for capture, private storage, exporter and view until all capture/read/consumer uses are confirmed finished. Release only owned resources in dependency order; never infer completion from dropped references. Do not retain a model/tensor beyond its existing observation/context, or add an unbounded allocation/caching lifetime.

requirements.name: Failure and primary error
requirements.requirement: Every allocation/capture/export/consume/release failure, deadline or interruption yields no success digest/receipt for that observation. Preserve the first failure and record cleanup errors without replacement. Unconfirmed consumers/transfers keep required ownership held; no retry, reused capture or promotion of failed/partial work. At context-entry CALL-019, the local cleanup try/timer have not begun: establish a future capture lifetime from its first allocation without assuming that handler will run.

requirements.name: Original guards and continuing clocks
requirements.requirement: Leave identity/version/owner/shape/dtype/device, hook/API/mode/RNG/native, no-param-grad, projection/selection/scoring, journal/fsync/source hashing, shutdown and idle guards fixed. Use original continuing clock domains and caps; no timer reset/extension or new observation window. No installed budget gate bypass.

requirements.name: Complete accounting and cost
requirements.requirement: Account for simultaneous source/private/exporter/bytes/bookkeeping/temporary lifetimes and actual peak RSS/allocator under unchanged caps. Include capture/copy/sync/export/hash/cleanup and all original phase endpoints; no overhead subtraction or nested-span double counting. Private copies may increase cost. Actual matched complete-unit/replay evidence is still required.

requirements.name: Admission remains separate
requirements.requirement: A requirements plan or fake-port transcript establishes no physical alias exclusion, target build join, numerical agreement, concurrency enforcement, memory fit, timing, recovery or operational admission. Existing copy and every fresh hash remain. Budget stays REJECT_CURRENT_ROUTE_FOR_NEW_SCOPE before protocol clock/ATTEMPT/connection.
